title: Birth in Texarkana and mother's hymns
summary: Taylor gives his birth place and date (January 1, 1894) and recalls his mother playing hymns on a foot organ and piano.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Okay, it's going. Do you want to give your name first? Well, my name is Jasper Taylor. Is Jasper where you're born?
The town right there on the border, isn't it?
Can you give us the birth date?
And you remember the very first music you heard?

Well, the very first music I heard was about my mother. She used to play the organ, the old-fashioned foot organ, and later on we bought a flat-top piano. And I always heard my mother play the hymns from the church books. And that's, I got my inspiration from my mother, I guess.
Anyone else in the family? Do you have any older brothers?
No, no. I had a sister. She passed when she was a child.
